init.description: Refresh groups: Fast = radios + connected clients. Slow = CPU/RAM/interfaces/port + SSID schedules. Daily = model/firmware. A MikroTik connection is optional and only used to resolve device hostnames from DHCP leases - fully decoupled from the Zyxel AP connection.
